deployables.name: Palace
deployables.desc: Your seat of power. Produces a bit of everything.

deployables.name: Shrine
deployables.desc: +1 legitimacy/turn, +1 per adjacent forest or mountain.

deployables.name: Archer
deployables.desc: 3 Attack, 5 Bombardment; +2 bomb per adjacent fortification.

deployables.name: Spearman
deployables.desc: 6 Attack, 6 Defense; +3 attack per adjacent cavalry.

deployables.name: Temple
deployables.desc: +1 progress, +1 more per temple you own.

deployables.name: City
deployables.desc: +3 progress, +1 production. Counts as a settlement.

deployables.name: Bath
deployables.desc: +3 food, +1 for each adjacent water tile.

deployables.name: Legionairre
deployables.desc: 15 atk / 15 def, +5/+5 per legionairre you own.

deployables.name: Star Fort
deployables.desc: 60 defense, +60 more if every surrounding tile is occupied.

deployables.name: Cog
deployables.desc: 30 attack, 30 defense; +30 bombardment when adjacent to an island.

deployables.name: Foreign Legion
deployables.desc: 60 atk / 60 def, +10/+10 per foreign legion you own.

deployables.name: Longbowman
deployables.desc: 8 land attack, 15 bombardment; +5 per adjacent fortification, +5 on hills.

deployables.name: Astral Legion
deployables.desc: 500 atk / 500 def, +50/+50 per astral legion you own.

deployables.name: Knight
deployables.desc: 50 defense; attack equal to legitimacy divided by 3.

deployables.name: Colosseum
deployables.desc: Gold equal to 3% of your land army attack.

deployables.name: Cossack
deployables.desc: 10 atk / 10 def, +1 attack per empty controlled tile.

deployables.name: Forge
deployables.desc: +1 production per hill or mountain within range 2.

deployables.name: University
deployables.desc: +1 progress to each progress-generating tile within range 2.

deployables.name: Bridge
deployables.desc: Triples the gold yield of all adjacent tiles.

deployables.name: Embassy
deployables.desc: Each combat, auto-hires 3 mercenaries in every domain, +1 for each adjacent tile you do not control.

techs.name: Burial Rites
techs.desc: When you lose a domain in combat, gain 4 progress.

techs.name: Caste System
techs.desc: +1 production per unique-era deployable you own.

techs.name: Astrology
techs.desc: Gain a free reroll each time you unlock a tech.

techs.name: Festivals
techs.desc: When you win a domain in combat, gain 4 food and 4 production.

techs.name: Rhetoric
techs.desc: Whenever you win a domain in combat, gain 15 legitimacy.

techs.name: Algebra
techs.desc: Reduce the cost of all future progress by 10% (rounded down).

techs.name: Crusades
techs.desc: Gain land attack equal to legitimacy divided by 2.

techs.name: Absolute Monarchy
techs.desc: Doubles the yield of the palace.

techs.name: Flying Buttress
techs.desc: Doubles the defense of all defense buildings.

techs.name: Banking
techs.desc: Gain 5% interest on banked gold at the end of each turn.

techs.name: Shipbuilding
techs.desc: Increase the stats of all naval units by 50%.

techs.name: Nationalism
techs.desc: Gain attack in all domains equal to legitimacy divided by 4.

techs.name: Bayonets
techs.desc: All melee units gain +10 attack and +10 defense.

techs.name: Melange
techs.desc: Multiply all gold from deserts by 10.

techs.name: Tribalism
techs.desc: Military units gain +1 attack for each other unit of the same type.

techs.name: Basket Weaving
techs.desc: Halve the distance cost of expansion (rounded down).

techs.name: Sacred Grounds
techs.desc: Controlled tiles without a deployable gain 1 defense.

techs.name: Trade Networks
techs.desc: Gain gold each turn equal to the distance to your farthest controlled tile.

techs.name: Philosophy
techs.desc: +1 progress per turn for each progress technology you have.

techs.name: Ecology
techs.desc: Deployables no longer remove the natural production of their tile.

techs.name: Specialization
techs.desc: Buildings generate a resource based on their type.

techs.name: Oral Tradition
techs.desc: All units gain +1 attack at the end of every turn.

techs.name: Hereditary Rule
techs.desc: At the end of each turn, the palace gains +1 to a random base yield.

techs.name: Monotheism
techs.desc: Temples also produce gold equal to their progress output.

techs.name: Tithing
techs.desc: Double the gold yield of temples.

techs.name: Citizenship
techs.desc: Double the progress yield of your settlements.

techs.name: Civil Service
techs.desc: Gain land attack and defense equal to your total settlement output.

techs.name: Feudalism
techs.desc: Plains tiles producing food adjacent to a settlement produce +2 food.

techs.name: Crop Rotation
techs.desc: Farms quadruple tile yields instead of doubling.

techs.name: Pilgrimage
techs.desc: Shrines with no adjacent buildings produce triple output.

techs.name: Hedgerows
techs.desc: All food buildings also gain +20 defense.

techs.name: Inquisition
techs.desc: Temples gain +attack and +defense equal to their progress output.

techs.name: Scientific Method
techs.desc: Increase the effect of all libraries, observatories, universities, and academies by 100%.

techs.name: Hospitality Rites
techs.desc: Enables hiring mercenaries in combat — spend gold for temporary attack (1/2/3/4 gold per point on land/sea/sky/space), only in domains where you already have a presence.

techs.name: Diplomatic Marriage
techs.desc: When hiring a mercenary, also gain 1 defense in that domain.

techs.name: Defensive Pact
techs.desc: When hiring a mercenary, also gain 2 defense in that domain.
